Schezwan Instant Noodles recipe
By: ravikumar
Published: Tuesday, January 9, 2018 - 3:00am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Secret Schezwan Instant Noodles
1 1/2 Cup (250ml) Water

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Boil 1 1/2 Cup (250ml) Water 3 Step 2: 4 Add noodles and the seasoning mix to the boiling water and cook for 2-3 mins. Stir Occasionally. 5 Serve Hot!

About

This Schezwan Instant Noodles Recipeis just delicious full of spicy nature. People just loved it because it's is cooked very fast and very tasty too. It’s a Desi Chinese Schezwan Instant Noodles Recipeeasy to make. It’s one of the favourite noodles of all Noodle-Lovers. Best in taste and quality noodles.
